comment: World Atlas Remaster 01 — protected landmarks OUTSIDE the A-4 master-core guard (or in its writable rim band). Each entry has a committed golden crop in goldens/<id>.png extracted from the accepted composite post-ocean-conform; packaging compares the shipped composite byte-wise against every golden (deep-teal water in the golden is exempt, the same exemption as the A-4 guard, because the global conform's statistics legitimately shift). Deliberate re-authoring of a landmark = re-extracting its golden in the same commit; the golden's git diff is the authorization. Derivation: PROTECTION_PLAN.md (ATLAS-C audit).
